item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 21/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring very hot weather to southern China in the next couple of days. Besides, the area of low pressure now over the seas east of Luzon may develop into a tropical cyclone, and will move across the vicinity of the Luzon Strait to the northeastern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. However, its development and movement remain uncertain. The associated unsettled weather will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week.
